# Icon (`icon`)

One SVG icon set for both renderers (Material Design Icons).

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIcon` (types in `dist/web/icons.d.ts`): `.mh-icon`: an inline SVG that takes `currentColor`.

```ts
export function createIcon(icon: IconName | string, options: IconOptions = {}): SVGSVGElement;

export interface IconOptions {
  /** Size in px; default follows the font size (1.25em). */
  size?: number;
  /** Accessible label; without one the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`). */
  label?: string;
  class?: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiSofaOutline } from '@mdi/js';
import { createIcon } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const room = document.createElement('p');
room.append(
  // Any Material Design Icons path works where there is no short name.
  createIcon(mdiSofaOutline, { size: 24 }),
  ' Living room ',
  createIcon('lightbulb-on', { size: 20, label: 'Lights on' }),
);

document.body.append(room);
```
